investigation.title: Remote Agents: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocking All Agent Provisioning Evals
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents feature checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-09-02T23:02–23:03Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error indicating the swarm provisioning gateway at the AWS ELB endpoint is unreachable. Because the failure occurs at POST /api/agents before any agent identity or VM state can be established, all required evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) is absent and every contract assertion is unverifiable.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway backing POST /api/agents (routed through an AWS ELB in us-east-2) returned HTTP 502 with error code bad_gateway and message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning" for every remote-agents check in this run. This is an upstream infrastructure failure localized to the swarm provisioning path: the production-api cannot reach the swarm ELB target, so no agent creation attempt can proceed and no evidence is collected. This is an eval-detected infrastructure signal; no user-traffic or incident data is present in the packet to confirm a broader production outage.

investigations.title: Remote Agent Provisioning: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocking All Remote-Agent Checks
investigations.summary: All three remote-agents eval checks (remote-agent-runtime, remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state) failed at 2026-09-02T23:02–23:03Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production-api could not reach the swarm ELB endpoint at /v1/agents during agent provisioning. Because agent creation is the first step in the remote-agent-runtime probe (run-status-probes.mjs line 1918: createAgent), the gateway failure prevented any evidence from being collected, causing a total contract gap across all five required fields.
investigations.rootCause: The swarm gateway — an AWS ELB in us-east-2 fronting /v1/agents — was unreachable from the production-api at the time of the eval run. Every remote-agents check that calls POST /api/agents received the same 502 response with error code bad_gateway and the message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning". Because createAgent is invoked before any evidence can be captured, zero evidence fields (orgId, agentId, model, provider, message) were returned, and the expected-output contract defined in infra/evals/status/check-expectations.json lines 266–270 was entirely unmet. This is an eval-infrastructure signal of a backend connectivity or availability problem localized to the swarm gateway layer; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.
